articleTitle: Perceived Trust and Enjoyment: Predicting Behavioural Intention to use Mobile Payment Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: This study examines the behavioral intention to use mobile payment services based on the technology acceptance model (TAM). The data was collected from users who had experience using FastPay and ZainCash Applications, the valid questionnaire was 209. The smart-PLS analyzed the proposed model, and the measurement and structural analysis were run to ensure reliability, validity, and to examine the proposed hypotheses. The results indicated that the perceived ease of use, perceived usefulness, perceived trust, and perceived enjoyment have a positive and significant impact on behavioral intention to use mobile payment. This study can assist the providers of mobile payment services in making decisions on how to grow their user base, as well as provide a clear image to the m-payment providers about the factors that users pay more attention such as trust and usefulness.

articleTitle: Recognition of American Sign Language Using Deep Convolution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Around 466 million individuals are deaf or hard of hearing worldwide. Those individuals must engage with others, learn new things, and participate in activities. Sign language serves as a link between them and the rest of the world. There are numerous problems in creating a system that can automatically recognize sign language. For that, we have developed models for American Sign Language, we used a dataset that represents the American Sign Language Alphabet, which includes 29 classes for all English sign language letters as well as three additional characters: "del", "nothing" and "space." The collection contains 10,208 in image format, with each class presented in a separate folder. 80 percent of the dataset was used for training, while 20 percent was used for testing. The accuracy of the results for the proposed system was 100%.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting Online Banking Adoption among Students During COVID-19: Case of Universiti Utara Malaysia-UUM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Online banking-OB is a new information system that uses the Internet's creative resources to allow users to access a growing variety of financial services. It offers that country an advantage over other countries in financial transactions. During the lockdown and implementation of social distancing, it was difficult for students to buy daily necessities in stores, and many Malaysians turned to the Internet to fulfil their purchasing requirements. This paper aims to explore the adoption of online banking and describe the factors affecting online banking adoption among undergraduate students at UUM. The data was collected through a quantitative approach using a random sampling technique. A total of 210 students were selected and filled out the questionnaire. The study found that most students adopt online banking, and perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, and consumer attitude represent most factors influencing online banking adoption.

articleTitle: Hardware considerations of a DSP based wireless coded receiver under limited resources
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Reliable wireless communication is enabled by adopting advanced Forward Error Correction (FEC) codes, such as Turbo codes. However, the Turbo decoder for real-time communication necessitates accommodating limited resources offered by the DSP processor. This motivates the benchmarking of the Super Harvard Architecture (SHARC) Digital Signal Processor (DSP), which is considered a high flexibility platform. However, implementing turbo code, which is based on the Bahl-Cocke-Jelinek-Raviv (BCJR) algorithm on DSP, requires extensive processing time and high memory usage due to its data dependencies. Motivated by this, the hardware considerations to implement a coded receiver under limited memory and processing time are proposed. A memory management strategy that terminates full memory concerns due to the data dependencies of the BCJR is presented. We show that by jointly optimizing the dynamic memory allocation and accessing the external memory, a significant improvement of the available computing resources and lessen the memory requirements. Results showed that the proposed coded receiver requires a memory size of 21 symbol lengths.

articleTitle: A Scalable Power Splitter using High Sheet Polysilicon Resistor Suitable for RFIC Application
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Integrated circuits employing CMOS RF technology are increasingly common and widely deployed. There are currently a wide range of materials available for use in the process that are optimised for RF noise, matching characteristics, and improved resistivity. In this paper, the highly resistive passive resistor component is used in the power splitter circuits, where a high sheet polysilicon resistor is the best choice. The high sheet polysilicon resistor and its extracted parasitic capacitance are shown to be the best match among the various resistors mentioned in the literature. Power splitter circuits use these resistor characteristics to get the best possible results, such as low return and insertion losses and good isolation. In order to get the desired resistor values for the power splitter’s individual components, twelve parallel high sheet poly resistors are employed. A total of six electronic componentsâtwo metal finger capacitors and four lumped element spiral inductorsâare employed. Power splitter and probe pad components from the layout are on display. The correctness of the layout is confirmed by simulations run before to and after layout. The design schematic, pre-layout and post layout simulation results confirms that high sheet polysilicon resistors are the best selected potential candidate for RFIC application.

articleTitle: Fit Online: A Mobile Application for Fitness and Recreation Services
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: This paper presents the fitness and recreation mobile app development on a smartphone or tablet that has a function to support the users to buy e-tickets and vendors to promote their commercial business through the app. This study aims to develop a mobile application for fitness and recreation services through object-oriented research, design, and development process that could meet the necessity of many users who like to purchase fitness and recreation e-tickets. The name of the mobile app is Fit Online. In the local market, no apps provide facilities to buy many vendors' tickets in a single platform. Beginners to advance level of the tutorial is not available in the current system. This app will provide social networking services to users who can share their daily fitness activities with other users. Customer care will communicate clearly and adapt to every user. This app will inspire a user to exercise, and the vendor will find a platform to explore their expertise. Both Fit Online and the vendor system will be online. Available vendor tickets will be synchronized automatically with Fit Online. A copy of the e-ticket will send to the customer, vendor, and Fit Online system. Vendors will get extra customers via this company commerce policy. It will save users time and cost. Vendor, user, and Fit Online will be beneficial.

articleTitle: Arabic Sign Language Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Deaf or hard of hearing person number roughly 466 million people globally. Individuals in this situation must interact with people, gain new skills, and participate in activities. They use sign language to communicate with the rest of the world. The development of an autonomous system to detect gesture language has various difficulties, particularly for Arabic sign language. We built models for Arabic Sign Language to accomplish this. We used the Arabic Alphabets Sign Language (ArSL) Dataset, which contains 32 categories of sign characters, A total of 40 people of various ages participated in these Arabic sign and letter classes. There are 506 images in each category, for a total of 506 * 32 = 16192 images. 80 percent of the dataset was used for training, while 20 percent was used for testing. The results of the proposed system were 100 percent accurate.

articleTitle: The Use of Biharmonic Dejdamrong Surface in Gray Image Enlargement Process
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: In this given study, the image enlargement method was investigated from the perspective of making use of biharmonic cubic Dejdumrong surfaces. It is common practice to resize a picture by upsampling or downsampling in order to accommodate a tiny image on a bigger screen (full-screen mode) or to decrease a high-quality image to a lower resolution. In contrast, this study will focus on picture enlargement utilizing a scaling factor of two owing to certain limitations. Biharmonic cubic Dejdumrong was employed in the investigation under various four-boundary curve conditions. This research looked at the effectiveness of the recommended approach by applying it to well-known grayscale test photos and calculating the peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), which is an indication of how well the strategy performed.

articleTitle: Survey of Micro Fluidic Phased Array Antenna for Beam Steering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: A spatially adaptable radio wire cluster (SAA) is an exhibit that can vary the actual field’s actual area. Ability to expand connect limit without employing an expanded boundary or many receive antenna components. This study presents a thorough examination of current microfluidic over 5G technologies and strategies. In this composition, a new RF feed arrangement is shown, along with the first SAA trial check that makes use of microfluidic-based reconfiguration. This study presents a thorough examination of current microfluidic over 5G technologies and strategies. The investigation’s goal was to create a component fix reception antenna using water-based fluidic stage shifters, where the pillar directing could be controlled by filling a few water channels for each antenna, and other approaches were put out by various researchers. These techniques have been broken down into categories that are easy to understand, such as the use of creating a stage Shifter and combining an array with a phase shifter. In each meeting, a limited number of excellent articles were examined and evaluated for idea confirmation. Finally, a comparison of various approaches was made.

articleTitle: Review on the Impact of Social Media Users’ Participation on Micro Small and Medium Enterprises Crowdfunding
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Micro Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) often do not fit the criteria for financing since self-financing is challenging due to their margins, and external finance is not always a choice because they do not always meet the standards of banks or financial markets. However, crowdfunding (CF) can help these businesses stay afloat and thrive as a new form of financial aid. MSMEs benefit from CF in terms of the level of innovation, growth potential, and financial success. Because the audience may give direct input on a product, it may be more helpful to the company than expert investors' business development recommendations. Not only can CF provide a new source of capital for innovative enterprises, but it can also provide new ideas and input, allowing the company to expand and improve its performance. This paper provides an insight into the review of CF participation from social media users based on the related Information System (IS) Theory by reviewing 50 journal articles and five articles are chosen for further evaluation. At the end of this paper, the authors note that CF could be a useful alternative financing method for Malaysian MSMEs to support the capital formation and fill funding gaps on the condition that they have support from the funders. In short, social media can have a significant positive impact on CF efforts by the MSMEs, which can assist in identifying people who genuinely support the company’s idea, as well as promoting the campaign to others who could be interested in giving and providing services. The outcome of this study is to propose an integrated model that illustrates the gaps in current understanding and possible future directions for research on participation in crowdfunding.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Authentication Public Blockchains
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: The internet of things (IoT) is an integrated, interconnected system of things without any human interaction. However, the lightweight internet of things devices have limited storage and processing capacity. Due to this limitation, a centralized authentication system was adopted on the internet of things. Unfortunately, the centralized authentication system has a lot of drawbacks, such as a single point of failure, cost, scalability, and bottleneck. Therefore, a decentralized system such as the public blockchain was introduced because it solves the drawbacks of decentralized authentication methods. This paper evaluates the performance of two authentication methods using a public blockchain. The two used blockchains for the evaluation are Rinkeby and Ropsten. The metrics used in the evaluation are time, CPU, and memory. These metrics are required in the authentication process during the association requests of members to their groups and in data message exchanges between them. The obtained results showed that Rinkeby is less time-, CPU-, and memory-consuming than Ropsten because it uses a proof of authority consensus algorithm, which depends on a lower number of participants, whereas Ropsten uses a proof of work consensus algorithm, which depends on a greater number of participants than a proof of authority.

articleTitle: Attack Resilience of Statistics-based Recently Used Cache Replacement Policy in Software-Defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Software-Defined Networking is a networking innovation that separates the traditional network into data plans and a controller. The data plans are used to forward data across the network based on flow entries generated by the controller and stored in the Ternary Content Addressable Memory (TCAM). However, since TCAM has a limited capacity, the switch is easily overflowed by creating high-rate malicious traffic causing frequent rule miss for legitimate traffic. When there is not enough space in the switch, it uses one of the eviction mechanisms to remove some entries to free up space. According to some studies, the Least Recently Used (LRU) outperforms other replacement algorithms and increases the switch-hit ratio by maintaining recently used rules in the switch. However, the LRU mechanism may be more vulnerable to attacks that intentionally request unpopular content. This paper evaluates the performance of LRU under DoS attacks when taking into account the rule statistics information over the last period of time in order to understand how well they improve the hit ratios and reduces the communication overhead for legitimate traffic. The simulation results show that using the statistics information along with recently used time can improve the cache attack resistance.

articleTitle: A Requirements Model for Cancer Patients’ Management System (CPMS): A Case of National Oncology Center – Hadramout, Yemen
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Despite more cancer patients are successfully treated, the cancer registry remains the main challenge in Yemen. The existing cancer registries in Yemen work separately without full coordination and collaboration. Having a comprehensive registry system would assist in planning, controlling, and evaluating cancer in Yemen. However, to date, there has not been any system or model for cancer patients’ management system (CPMS). The standard or generic requirements can help in the system development phase and would improve the reliability of the system deliverables. Therefore, the main aim of this study is to construct a requirements model for CPMS by using Unified Modeling Language (UML). The Agile Kanban method was employed to achieve the study objective. This method has gained significant importance in managing software engineering projects due to its flexibility, responsiveness, and reliability. The results demonstrated the requirements model of CPMS using three core UML diagrams: use case diagram, sequence diagram, and class diagram. Then, a prototype was developed based on the CPMS requirements model. Then, five experts were involved in evaluating the usability of the CPMS prototype. The evaluation results showed positive feedback from the users on the usefulness and ease of use of the CPMS prototype.

articleTitle: Generalized Harmonic DP-Ball Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: In this paper, we illustrate a method based on the elliptic partial differential operators in which a boundary control point is used to control the whole surface. The present method will give higher flexibility in image interpolation. This method uses two opposite defined boundaries to generate the Delgado and Pena Ball (DP-Ball) surface. In particular, we concentrate on the analysis of the harmonic surfaces of the DP-Ball. The most important discovery is that any harmonic DP-Ball surface will enable the generation and control of the overall surface based on the boundary curves rather than a set of control points. Harmonic DP-Ball patches of grade 2 and degree 3 were chosen to show how the proposed process would work.

articleTitle: Software Security Measurements: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Security metrics for software products give a quantifiable assessment of a software system’s trustworthiness. Metrics can also help detect vulnerabilities in systems, prioritize corrective actions, and raise the level of information security within the business. There is a lack of studies that identify measurements, metrics, and internal design properties used to assess software security. Therefore, this paper aims to survey security measurements used to assess and predict security vulnerabilities. We identified the internal design properties that were used to measure software security based on the internal structure of the software. We also identified the security metrics used in the studies we examined. We discussed how software refactoring had been used to improve software security. We observed that a software system with low coupling, low complexity, and high cohesion is more secure and vice versa. Current research directions have been identified and discussed.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Edge Computing for 6G
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Edge computing is a new technology that enables 6G development by bringing cloud capabilities closer to end users to overcome traditional cloud flaws such as high latency and a lack of security. Few studies identify recent advances, challenges, and opportunities in 6G edge computing. As a result, this paper presents a review to identify recent advances in edge computing in 6G. It also discusses the challenges and opportunities of such new trends in the computing landscape. The paper identifies challenges (security and privacy, offloading and task division, bandwidth, service management, advanced communication, general-purpose computing on edge nodes, quantum computing and edge computing, and IoT heterogeneous platforms) as well as opportunities (academic-industry collaborations, algorithms and libraries that are lightweight and virtualization and micro-operating systems). Finally, some conclusions have been drawn after identifying current research directions.

articleTitle: Designing a device to guide the steps of doing physiotherapy exercises based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Today, intelligent circuits are one of the main parts of electronic devices. They are also used in medical devices in many fields. For example, physiotherapy devices use these circuits to help patients get better quickly and facilitate treatment. Physiotherapy or physical therapy treats neuromuscular-skeletal diseases and disorders using mechanical equipment, electrical currents, and manual and physical exercises. Studies have shown that using a home physiotherapy device can significantly alleviate the use of painkillers. The result is greatly enhanced when using a home physiotherapy device and techniques, such as relaxation therapy, biofeedback, visualization, exercise, nerve block injection, or spinal manipulation. This paper will introduce an intelligent guiding device for Physiotherapy Exercises that can help patients remember their practices. This device helps old patients and those who forget their exercise programs in their treatment process. Also, this device is capable of showing the patient how to do the exercises correctly.

articleTitle: Conceptual Model for Automating GDPR Compliance Verification Using Natural Language Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Most mobile apps require regular access to sensitive personal information. Regulators are increasingly demanding mobile app makers disclose privacy policies that detail what users’ data is gathered and used. Compliance with data privacy and protection regulations must be monitored to reduce legal penalties that may come from unexpected data breaches. Checking and verifying The General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Compliance is quite a challenging issue. In this paper, we propose, an extension to be added to the automated GDPR compliance verification tool. This extension shows how the questions about the compliance of mobile applications might be answered based on GDPR standards. The implementation phases of the extension are explained. It includes query processing, document retrieval, passage retrieval, and answer extraction. This paper provides mobile application developers with a better technique of how to monitor users' compliance with mobile application privacy policies.

articleTitle: Student Abnormal Behavior Detection Using Dlib Combined With YOLO Models
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: In the last years, educational technology has advanced tremendously. To better serve their students, schools and universities are moving online. AI-based proctoring solutions have also grabbed the industry, and online proctoring services are rising. Online proctoring systems (OPS) generally use online tools to ensure the examination is conducted with integrity. This study shows how to develop a multi-model system using computer vision to avoid and analyze anomalous student behavior during exams. The system incorporates mouth open/close detection, object identification, head posture assessment, and face detection utilizing Dlib facial landmarks and Yolo models. Our system also proposed a novel way of analyzing student behavior by analyzing the student’s computer screen using a deep neural network model learned from our developed dataset, "AppScreenshotDS." This work achieves good detection accuracy, where the "Tasks Detection" model achieves 0.87 mean Average Precision (mAP) on the developed dataset and the "Behavioral Analyses Model" achieves 0.95 accuracies. We conclude that our proposal provides a novel method for detecting abnormal student behavior by analyzing what is on the student’s computer screen using deep learning.

articleTitle: Essential of RFID Technology in Supply Chain Management: A review on Digital Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Barcode has been identified as the main tool in supply chain management (SCM) science since the 1970s. Recently, the growing interest of many industries have emphasised cost saving by implementing radio frequency identification (RFID) technology. This paper provides an overview of RFID’s technical characteristics and implications in supply chains. The paper also highlights the advantages of inventory control and management that assists organization to understand how RFID provides comprehensive services with a cost-saving approach. Thus, this paper can be used as a resource for future studies in this area.

articleTitle: Privacy Preserving Enhancing Model for Multiple-sensitive Attributes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Recently, there is a demand of publishing sensitive data about individuals for many research reasons. However, this will compromise the privacy of the individuals. Therefore, anonymity concept needed to be applied on the data before publishing it. The problem is that most of anonymity models will have information leak when dealing with multiple sensitive attributes. In this paper, a privacy preserving enhancing model for multiple sensitive attributes is presented based on the Anatomy. This model can be achieved by clustering the data based on the Anatomy principles on sensitive attributes together using Single Sensitive Bucketization SSB. M-Buckets algorithm is presented and compared with Anatomy algorithm. Results show better privacy preserving for the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Saviour: A Smart Multi-Input & Output Flood Comprehensive Management System based on IoT & Location
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Flash floods are considered life-threatening and have an unfavorable impact on public health, economic activities, the environment, and cultural heritage in many countries worldwide. This study presents the design, implementation, and testing of telemetry stations as part of an ongoing project aiming to construct a smart multi-input and output flood comprehensive management system based on the internet of things and location called Saviour. Obtaining a robust design architecture for Saviour requires content analysis of 15 existing flood management systems. The results showed that the architectural design of Saviour’s telemetry stations is characterized by effortless installation and maintenance in a manner that allows the villagers to carry out routine maintenance work. Moreover, the results showed that the telemetry stations can switch automatically to stand-alone flood self-warning systems in case of an Internet failure. Besides, the results showed that Saviour is able to present high-accuracy real-time data with an error rate that does not exceed 0.90%, and the stations can be configured locally or remotely.

articleTitle: Statistical Features and PageRank Scoring Fusion for Arabic Text Summarization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: online text content is increasing daily, making it a big challenge for readers to find the required information. So, providing a gist of the available text content can help those readers save their time and effort. This operation is completed by Automatic Text Summarization (ATS), which creates a summary for the entire text. Automatic Text Summarization can be achieved by many techniques, such as graph theory, statistics, machine learning, and clustering methods. Each of the above techniques takes care of a specific issue of text which other techniques do not. Text summarization for the Arabic language suffers from a lack of resources and language complexity. So, it is worthwhile to take the advantages of two or more text summarization techniques and fuse them together to improve their performance and enhance their summary quality. This study proposes a method that combines two of the ATS methods, which are the statistical based method and the graph-based modified PageRank algorithm. Graph-based techniques take care of relationships among document sentences, whereas statistical-based techniques take care of signalizing important sentences. Experiment results show that proposed method achieved a good performance. The Essex Arabic Summaries Corpus (EASC) was used as evaluation data.

articleTitle: Big Data De-duplication Using Classification Scheme based on Histogram of File Stream
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Modern technologies generate millions of data every second. Managing and storing this data is very challenging. Data deduplication reduces storage requirements and data redundancy. It is one of the most effective solutions for Big data storage. This paper proposes a new method to accelerate and improve the deduplication technique. It separates the data into many classes before entering the deduplication system based on the Pearson correlation between the histograms of different data extensions. A new method has been developed to divide the file appropriately by generating a list of divisors based on data repeating patterns. In addition, a mathematical algorithm is proposed to construct the hash functions for each chunk that are twice faster as traditional hash functions (MD5 and SHA-1). As a result, the Deduplication Ratio (DR) of the proposed method is about ten times more potent than the Basic Sliding Window (BSW) method and approximately five times more powerful than the Two Thresholds Two Divisors (TTTD) method.

articleTitle: Blockchain technology adoption in SMEs: the extended model of UTAUT
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to measure the behavioral intention to adopt blockchain technology (BT) among SME managers based on the theory of "Unified theory of acceptance and use of technology" (UTAUT).The study was conducted among SME managers in Iraq who adopted blockchain technology. The study deployed the quantitative method and the purposive sample technique was used. The data collected by questionnaires and the valid questionnaires was 192 analyzed by Smart-PLS after ensuring the validity and reliability of the proposed model.The results indicated that performance expectancy, facilitating conditions, technology readiness, and blockchain transparency positively and significantly impact SME managers' intention to adopt blockchain technology. On the other hand, social influence has an insignificant impact on BI’s decision to adopt the blockchain among SME managers.

articleTitle: Event-Based Rumor Detection using LSTM Models For Arabic Content on Twitter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Due to the flexibility of sharing and exchanging information, Microblogging networks such as Twitter have become more and more popular over the last few years. The nature of social media as well provides a rich and facilitated ground for rumormongers to spread false stories and information that may result in major mess and unpredictable reactions from involved individuals. Detecting rumors automatically at their early formative and diffusion phases is particularly crucial to minimize their negative and catastrophic effects. Many effective solutions to detect rumors on Twitter have been presented over the last few years. However, most of the researches were limited to certain languages, such as English and Chinese. Few studies focused on the Arabic Language; Most of those studies were concerned only to detect rumors at the tweet-level and neglecting event-level based detection. In this paper, we built two RNN-LSTM deep learning models to classify Arabic Twitter content as rumor or non-rumor more efficiently utilizing linguistic features. The constructed models are capable to detect rumor events on Twitter. An attention mechanism was embedded to optimize the performance of these models where they achieved accuracy above 93%.

articleTitle: Digitalization of freight transport and logistics industry in Malaysia
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: This study investigates the current digitalisation trends in the freight transport and logistics industry in Malaysia. A qualitative research method was employed to conduct an in-depth interview based on three digitalization themes: connecting, collaborating and capitalising. The results of this study are discussed under each theme based on structured questions related to key technologies that are evolving industry. The results reveal that digitalization level for the future competitiveness of the industry adopts at the basic level and not at an advanced level. The results of this study also highlight that direction between digital strategies and industry transformation is not ascertained. These findings is hoped to assist government and freight logistics service providers in strategizing the existing current structure for digital technology adoption for overall business productivity.

articleTitle: Exploring Critical Challenges and Factors Influencing E-Learning Systems Security During COVID-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic swiftly forced the closure of higher education institutions across the world. As a result, all educational institutions have made a considerable move toward e-learning. E-learning systems suffer from confidentiality, integrity, and availability-related security threats. Hence, understanding this problem from various perspectives that include technology, human behavior, management, and policies, as well as implementing policies and standards will assist in finding the most influencing factors that can help in protecting e-learning information systems from potential security threats. In this research, a review has been conducted to analyze and assess 55 states of the art articles on e-learning security and to identify countermeasures to strengthen e-learning information systems. The study contributes to our understanding of how to strengthen the e-learning information systems security by answering the following questions: What are the factors that have an impact on the e-learning systems vulnerability during the COVID-19 pandemic? What are the most important technology, management, and environment-based factors that need to be considered for protecting e-learning systems from potential security attacks?. The results of this study will enable decision and policymakers at higher education institutions to better understand the essential elements of adopting an e-learning system. Knowing these factors will help the designers and developers of e-learning systems adopt secure software design and development methodologies to reduce the likelihood that such vulnerabilities and it contributes to enhancing the system's security resilience against potential attacks. In addition, university management will be more knowledgeable about how to instruct their staff and students on best practices for using e-learning web applications.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Authentication-based Traffic Offence Control and Enforcement System on Smart Mobile Devices for Smart City
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: The evolution of communication and information technology in today's time should not despise the various practical aspects of daily life, regardless of economic, education, health, or other government services. Various functions of smart mobile devices meet the needs of users in many ways, where different mechanisms like templates, locks, fingerprints, and passwords are used to protect those functions. Due to the increased number of vehicles in smart cities, it becomes difficult for traffic officers with less manpower to complete many of their tasks related to registration, license, and issuance of summons in time, even reviewing the traffic violation's history. In addition, existing traffic systems are not real-time, data related to traffic management can be lost at any time, leading to the wastage of money and resources. To overcome these difficulties in smart cities, this paper proposes a fingerprint authentication-based traffic offence control-and-enforcement system on smart mobile devices. This scheme introduces a security framework to facilitate many tasks related to identification, registration, licensing, and issuance of summons to traffic violators by implementing fingerprint authentication. Functionality tests and user acceptance tests related to traffic offence problems have been conducted on the proposed system by analyzing biometric data of vehicle users' fingerprints.

articleTitle: Estimation Large- Scale Fading Channels for Transmit Orthogonal Pilot Reuse Sequences in Massive MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) is a critical technology for future fifth-generation (5G) systems. Reduced pilot contamination (PC) enhanced system performance, and reduced inter-cell interference and improved channel estimation. However, because the pilot sequence transmitted by users in a single cell to neighboring cells is not orthogonal, massive MIMO systems are still constrained. We propose channel evaluation using orthogonal pilot reuse sequences (PRS) and zero forced (ZF) pre-coding techniques to eliminate channel quality in end users with poor channel quality based on channel evaluation, large-scale shutdown evaluation, and analysis of maximum transmission efficiency. We derived the lower bounds on the downlink data rate (DR) and signal-to-interference noise ratio (SINR) that can be achieved based on PRS assignment to a group of users where the number of antenna elements mitigated the interference when the number of antennas reaches infinity. The channel coherence interval limitation, the orthogonal PRS cannot be allocated to all UEs in each cell. The short coherence intervals able to reduce the PC and improve the quality of channel. The results of the modelling showed that higher DR can be achieved due to better channel evaluation and lower loss.

articleTitle: Decision Tree based Smart System for Pregnant Women Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: one of the reasons of women and newborns death in developing countries is the complications during pregnancy and childbirth. An early diagnosis of pregnancy problems would help to alleviate some of these risks. In this work, a suggested solution to help the physicians for fast pregnant diagnosis is proposed. A smart system is designed for easing women diagnosis during pregnancy. The core purpose of this research work is to build up an Android application which gives a deliberate approach in providing the best diagnosis of pregnancy so that women will not be caught in the is the complications during pregnancy. Android application uses Machine Learning algorithms such as decision tree algorithm. In this paper, decision tree algorithm (DT) is used for predicting pregnancy states, which performs better and more robust than the other models. The best diagnosis of pregnancy is predicted using C4.5 and CART algorithms. Proposed system had used decision tree algorithms that employed a database of the most diseases associated with women during pregnancy. Pregnant women is interacted with proposed system via an android application mobile interface, they had provided the algorithm with the case conditions, which processed to guide both physician and pregnant women on the level of risk. Response of the system is based on input data that processed according to predetermined variables and decision tree outcomes. Implemented experiments had proofed the efficiency of the system to facilitate diagnosis for better pregnant mothers' health care. The CART algorithm has gained a better level of evaluation comparing to other C4.5 algorithm. CART algorithm has achieved the highest correctly classified instances and incorrectly classified instances, which were 89.65% in correctly classified instances, 90.77 % in incorrectly classified instances, 9.23% evaluation measure.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Intelligent Machine Learning for Cardiovascular Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) algorithms have resulted in considerable changes to health care, enabling early detection and diagnosis, including the classification and identification of Heart Disease (HD). The identification of HD through ML can aid practitioners in making accurate decisions regarding a patient’s health. This is a significant development due to HD now being the most prevalent disease worldwide, while its early diagnosis helps to save the patient’s life. ML algorithms reduce and understand HD symptoms. This study therefore proposes a novel approach differing from simple supervised ML algorithms. The research performed a comparative analysis using the dimensionality reduction algorithm known as Independent Component Analysis, as well as the ensemble technique and the Artificial Neural Network. The information employed for this analysis was obtained from the UCI ML Repository called Heart Disease. The proposed Artificial Neural Network and Adaboosting classifier demonstrated an accuracy in relation to the benchmark dataset of 0.880% and 0.821%, respectively. We thus concluded that that the dimensionality reduction of the Independent Component Analysis based classifier revealed a positive outcome, although with less accuracy than boosting and Multilayer Perceptron. To determine the performance of the algorithms, we used an accuracy score, precision, recall and F1-Score.

articleTitle: A Review on Requirements Prioritization Approaches of Software Project Management
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Planning, executing, monitoring, and managing software projects are the primary concerns of software project management (SPM). SPM is a branch of the broader project management discipline. SPM covers the knowledge, methods, and tools required to manage software project development. An essential part of SPM is requirements prioritization, which is used to decide which features or needs will be executed first or which releases will include those features or requirements. At the outset of any software development process and project, requirements are elicited, and the projects will be chosen based on their worth to the market and the product itself. However, the existing requirements prioritization approaches fail to consider all the necessary factors to establish these priority demands. Some of these factors are risk, time to market, value, the total number of requirements, cost, and the outcomes of both functional and non-functional requirements. Therefore, this paper aims to review the existing requirements prioritization approaches used in SPM. To reach this goal, a narrative review methodology was used to evaluate and summarise a body of scientific literature that came from a number of different scientific sources. The results confirm that there are several approaches used in SPM to prioritize the requirements in descending order of importance. Nonetheless, the discussion in this review is restricted to just 17 different studies. The authors provide an overview of the main results and suggest further research directions. This study may guide both researchers and practitioners toward the best method for doing the requirements prioritization task.

articleTitle: E-Learning Systems Success through Video Conferencing Software Platforms: Measurement Items and Validation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Computer-assisted learning has received more and more attention during the very recent years. Researchers in the field have deeply investigated e-learning to promote its success. Perusing the related literature reveals that a majority of e-learning studies mainly focused on conventional learning theories to collect the constructs needed to evaluate the e-learning systems success. Although they have been successful to some extent, more studies are required to cover the tenets of connectivism, the most recent theory of learning, and add other neglected but potential features to update the list of promising constructs to enhance the existing models. Therefore, the essential constructs towards the e-learning systems success were extracted by performing a systematic literature review (SLR). Then, the potential variables were gathered in a measurement instrument for hypothesizing their relationship. Accordingly, the present study aims to validate and confirm the items to evaluate the extracted constructs towards the elearning systems success via video conferencing to ensure the benefits and the success of the e-learning systems for efficient learning in both common and uncommon situations. To validate the measurement items, seven experts from the first five top research universities in Malaysia were invited to review the items in terms of relevancy and simplicity. All items and the entire scale passed the acceptable standard for validity.

articleTitle: Towards Studying the Relationship between Job Satisfaction and Organizations’ Information Security
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Recently, all organizations have held a variety of data, including product and customer insights. These data frequently contain sensitive information that, if revealed, destroyed, or deleted, would result in significant financial loss. Information security is the concept that focuses on securing the information of organizations. It prevents unauthorized access or alteration by malicious attackers or organizations' employees. Job satisfaction is a key factor that organizations seek to achieve for their employees. Hence, employees become more committed and are in a state of loyalty and attachment to the organization and its goals. Although many studies have been conducted on job satisfaction and the information security; however, there are still gaps that need to be filled in the literature. Therefore, this paper aims to explicate the related studies in order to find the relationship between job satisfaction and organizations’ information security, and to examine their impacts on each other. To do so, this study employed the exploratory research design because it concentrates on gaining insights and well-grounded information for the investigation. Three phases, which are (1) identifying the problem, (2) reviewing the literature, and (3) synthesizing and reporting the findings, were followed to achieve the aim of this study. The results indicate a vital relationship exists between job satisfaction and the organizations' information security leveraging the business organizations. Further research would focus on examining this relationship through interviews with experts in business organizations and surveying the impact of employee job satisfaction on the organizations' information security.

articleTitle: Strategic Information System Planning: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: this paper aims to make a review of the strategic planning of information systems, its sections, and uses in the public and private sectors, as well as seeking to raise awareness of the importance of strategic planning for information systems for organizations and their alignment with the business strategy of a public or private institution. The strategic planning of information systems has been classified in this paper into five sections, in which we talked about the strategic planning of information systems and its stages in the first section, as well as the importance of strategic planning for information systems in the second section, and we touched upon some of the requirements of strategic planning for information systems in the third section. In the fourth section, the challenges facing the strategic planning of information systems and some of the solutions through which the challenges were addressed were mentioned. In the fifth and final section, we mentioned the use of strategic planning for information systems in governmental and private institutions as well as religious and health institutions. Through research and review of previous studies, it was found that there are other challenges facing the strategic planning of information systems, including those organizations and institutions that face due to wars and interruptions in supplies of equipment, cadres, and others. as the challenges that organizations and institutions face because of governments that do not encourage or support organizations in implementing strategic planning for information systems, whether they are public or private institutions.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligence in Reducing Energy Consumption in Lighting
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: According to the importance of optimal lighting consumption management, this study investigates the relationship between light-emitting diode and different types of sensors to have better illuminance and consumption. Research on light-emitting diodes has shown that other classes can help the growing trend of this saving. However, there are still problems in between, one of which is the waste of electricity, is time to turn the lamps on and off. The other problem was the dual-mode (on / off) of the sensors, which provided detailed results in both cases. We advise BH1750FVI as optical sensor that rarely used in past research and, HC-SR501 as motion detector. The results showed that the proposed methods significantly reduce energy consumption. The findings may be helpful in future smart homes and smart cities.

articleTitle: Assessment on the Quality of Outer Model in Path Model for MOOC Instrument
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) received a great attention in Malaysia to support the online learning activity in Malaysia Higher Education. However, the low completion rate and overall use of the system was reported, thus raised question regarding students’ willingness to continue use the system. Accordingly, to capture this issue, data from survey method constructed from different variables and items need to be validated empirically as an initial standpoint in identifying the problem of low completion rate. Hence, the assessment of validity needs to be carried out. This paper reports the procedure of the assessment of outer model in path model approach by using newly origin second generation multivariate statistical technique of Partial Least Squares - Path Model (or Structural Model), PLSPM. The objective of the study is to analyse the outer model focusing the reflective modes in PLSPM based model. Data was collected through online survey from students enrolled in MOOC in Malaysia Higher Education Institutions. Before evaluating the structural model or inner model, an assessment of outer model or measurement model which relies on two main criteria called reliability and validity was run to determine how specified the measured. These involve the internal consistency, (Cronbach alpha and composite reliability), construct validity (loading), convergent validity (AVE), and discriminant validity (Fornell-Larcker criterion, cross-loading and HTMT criterion). Results concluded that the outer model has achieved their validity and reliability. Thus, the instrument used for this survey confirm the internal consistency, convergent validity, and discriminant validity, thus can be used in future research.

articleTitle: Well-designed Electronic Portfolio as a Facilitator for EFL Engineering Learners Reading Skill
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Technology, System and Service for Internet of Everything (ITSS-IoE)
abstract: The electronic portfolios have been widely accepted as the tool for enhancing learners writing skills in higher education. However, it is found that engineering college students engage less in reading compared to listening and writing. This study aims to find the structure of well-designed e-portfolios applied to improve reading competency. The quantitative survey questionnaire is employed and results show the e-portfolios factors including learning interest, learning length, learning strategy, learning environment, reflection and group work all contribute to the promotion of EFL engineering learning implicating the teaching design and pedagogy in further study.
